result.topic_en: Bare calculations with integrals over $[-a,a]$ of functions $\Lambda,\Lambda_1$ satisfying fourth-order differential equations with eigenvalue parameters $\lambda,\lambda_1$, using integration by parts to derive orthogonality-type relations (apparently related to vibrations of a plate or rod, with sine/sinh-type solutions).
result.transcription:
[-$2\sqrt{-1}\lambda \cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a \cos\sqrt{1+\lambda}\,a \, \partial t_\lambda$-]
$2\sqrt{-1}\,\lambda \sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,\sin\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\; t_\lambda = \frac{1}{2\lambda}\int_{-a}^{+a} \Lambda\left(u-\lambda\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right) - \frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}\,\partial x$
$= \frac{1}{2\lambda}\int_{-a}^{+a} \Lambda u + \Lambda'\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} - \frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}\right)\partial x$
$= \frac{1}{2\lambda}\left(\int_{-a}^{+a}\left(\Lambda\left(u - \frac{\partial^4 u}{\partial x^2\partial y^2} - \frac{\partial^4 u}{\partial x^4}\right) - \Lambda'\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)\partial x - 2\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}\right) + 2\Lambda\left(\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x\partial y^2} + \frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x^3}\right)\right)$ [?]

$\int_{-a}^{+a}\left(\Lambda\Lambda_1 + \lambda\lambda_1\Lambda\Lambda_1 - \frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial^2\Lambda_1}{\partial x^2}\right)\partial x = X$
$= -\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x}\frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2} + \Lambda_1\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3} + \lambda\int_{-a}^{+a}\Lambda_1\left(\Lambda(\lambda_1+\lambda) - 2\frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\right)\partial x$
$= -\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x}\frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2} + \Lambda_1\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3} - 2\lambda\Lambda_1\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x} + \lambda\int_{-a}^{+a}\left(\Lambda_1\Lambda(\lambda_1+\lambda) + 2\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x}\right)\partial x$
$X_\lambda(\lambda_1-\lambda) = -\left(\lambda_1\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x}\frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\right) + \left(\lambda_1\Lambda_1\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3}\right) - 2\lambda\lambda_1\left(\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\Lambda_1\right)$
$+\left(\lambda_1\Lambda_1\left(\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3} - \lambda\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\right) - \left(\lambda_1\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2} - \lambda\Lambda\right)\right)\right)$

$\lambda_1\Lambda_1\left(\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3} - \lambda\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\right) + \lambda\frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\frac{\partial^2\Lambda_1}{\partial x^2} - \lambda_1\Lambda_1$

$\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3}\lambda_1\Lambda_1 - \frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\lambda_1\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\lambda\left(\frac{\partial^2\Lambda_1}{\partial x^2} - 2\lambda_1\Lambda_1\right)$
$+\lambda\Lambda\left(2\frac{\partial\Lambda_1}{\partial x}\lambda_1 - \frac{\partial^3\Lambda_1}{\partial x^3}\right)$

$\frac{\partial^3\Lambda}{\partial x^3}\qquad \frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\qquad \frac{\partial\Lambda}{\partial x}\qquad \Lambda$

$(a+b)(c+d) - (a-b)(c-d) = 2(ad+bc)$
[-$c+d$-]
$\frac{\partial^4\Lambda}{\partial x^4}\lambda_1\Lambda_1 - \frac{\partial^2\Lambda}{\partial x^2}\left[(\lambda-\lambda_1)\frac{\partial^2\Lambda_1}{\partial x^2} - 2\lambda_1\Lambda_1\right]$
$+\lambda\Lambda\left(2\frac{\partial^2\Lambda_1}{\partial x^2}\lambda_1 - \frac{\partial^4\Lambda_1}{\partial x^4}\right)$

methods.what: Integration by parts of a bilinear integral of two eigenfunctions to reduce it to boundary terms (orthogonality relation)
Multiplying by eigenvalue difference to express the integral via boundary terms
Algebraic identity for products of sums and differences
Expression of coefficient $t_\lambda$ as an integral over $[-a,a]$ involving trigonometric factors
